Lena: Heads up 2 failed large charges in last run: one card decline (do_not_retry) and one ACH setup failed (invalid_account). Both are high-touch customers.

billing-bot: Automated alert: INV-9701 (card do_not_retry, $12,400), INV-9702 (ACH setup failed, $9,800). At-risk MRR: $22,200.

Omar: For the card do_not_retry we should NOT auto-retry. Mark manual-collect and trigger card-update email + AE ping.

Priya: For the ACH invalid_account: switch to micro-deposits and pause scheduled debits. Also send the customer the onboarding checklist for ACH (routing/account format).

Lena: Requesting approval to: (1) mark INV-9701 manual-collect and send card-update email with Reply WIRE option, (2) start ACH micro-deposit flow for INV-9702 and notify customer, (3) log both actions to invoice history.

Sasha: Approve. Add condition: when we trigger micro-deposits, include previous failed attempt metadata in the payment method notes. Also ping assigned AE for both customers.

Omar: I'll update the retry CLI to exclude do_not_retry and to attach metadata. CLI dry-run: ./billing retry --exclude-code do_not_retry --dry-run --log
If dry-run looks good we'll proceed.

billing-bot: Actions queued: manual_collect_flag(INV-9701), ach_microdeposit_start(INV-9702), ticket FIN-4705 created.

Lena: Dry-run OK. Executing live ops now and posting audit CSV to FIN/collections/1842501234.csv. Closing thread and tracking FIN-4705 for follow-ups.
